description: One Folketinget committee question (udvalgsspørgsmål, alm. del) together with the minister's answer, as a single structured record: question text, who asked it (name, party) and who else, committee, case, dates, the answering minister (office title and the office holder's name), the FULL answer text extracted from the published answer file (PDF or Word), the files attached to both, and the source document id. Give the question or answer document id, a Folketinget website address of either, or committee abbreviation + question number + session (e.g. committee ERU, question_number 140, session 20252). A question that has no answer yet comes back with answer_status not_yet_answered and answer null, never empty fields; a preliminary answer is labelled preliminary_only. Long answers page with offset/max_chars. Text is Danish. Source: Folketinget, parliamentary document register.

committee.description: Committee abbreviation as used in the register, e.g. "ERU", "SUU", "FIU". With question_number.

document_id.description: Dokument id of the question OR of its answer (type Spørgsmål or Svar), e.g. 1237262.

max_chars.description: Max characters of answer text to return (default 100000, max 400000).

offset.description: Character offset into the answer text, for paging (default 0).

question_number.description: Question number within the committee and session, e.g. 140.

session.description: Parliamentary session code, e.g. "20261" (2026-27) or "20252" (2025-26, 2nd session). Default: the current session.

url.description: A Folketinget website address of the question or answer file, or a /spm/<n>/ address.

name: folketinget_dk_get_question_answer

answer.description: null only when answer_status is not_yet_answered

text.description: Full answer text (paged); null when reason is set

found.description: False when the document, address or question number matches nothing in the register

title: Folketinget Dk Get Question Answer
